summary: The Prepare panel's Interview preparation guide replaces interview questions (#2615, #2621). You describe the interview, its length, who you meet by role and the topics to cover, such as salary, and choose an essential guide for a short screen or an extensive one for a longer interview (#2616). Research on the employer, the role and the field comes first and keeps recent sources rated by reliability (#2617). The guide holds a requirement matrix, weak points with defense lines, a pitch, stories, likely questions with the trap to avoid, questions to ask and a checklist; every sentence cites a career fact, an admitted gap or a research finding, and sentences that fail are listed as left out (#2618, #2619, #2620, #2632). Guides download as Word, PDF or Markdown and agents can read them (#2622). Earlier interview question sets stay readable.
knownLimitations: Guides have not been walked with a paid run yet (#2623). An essential guide costs at most US$0.20 and an extensive one US$0.40, plus research capped at US$0.08 or US$0.15. A pay range appears only from a dated source research finds. On the hosted staging service, drafting needs model screening, which stays off there until Claude on Vertex AI is available. The free-form cover letter writer is off unless a server sets DRAFT_LOOP_COVER_LETTER_WRITER=free-form. French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The local-first desktop has no career interview or Prepare panel.
